serviceName: K8 HQ: DMARC record, reports to K8 HQ (does not move your mail). Approve only if you are setting up K8 HQ yourself right now.
description: Adds a DMARC record in monitoring mode (p=none) that asks receivers to send aggregate reports to dmarc@ the domain, which K8 HQ reads. Offered only when the domain has no DMARC record. Does not change MX.
